reply.text: {"say":"Back leads with pull-ups, a heavy row, a pulldown and a chest-supported row, then biceps finish with three curls at different angles.","title":"Back & Biceps","days":[{"name":"Back & Biceps","exercises":[{"key":"pull-up","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Full hang at the bottom, chest to the bar"},{"key":"barbell-bent-over-row","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Flat back, pull to the lower ribs"},{"key":"neutral-grip-cable-lat-pulldown","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Drive elbows down to your sides"},{"key":"dumbbell-chest-supported-row","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Squeeze shoulder blades together at the top"},{"key":"ez-bar-biceps-curl","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Elbows pinned, no swinging"},{"key":"dumbbell-incline-curl","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Let arms hang fully for the stretch"},{"key":"cable-rope-hammer-curl","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Thumbs up, slow on the way down"}]}],"unmet":[]}
